scope: LivePreviewPanel source/mask _ZoomView pixmap item cache setup, image/resize/zoom changes and painting relevant to one exact Qt2 cached-preview test. Benchmark sampling/order/attribution is owned by review_701.

reported_failure_context.claim_limit: Reported failure motivates review; source alone establishes neither regression nor flaky-cause diagnosis.

correctness_findings.finding: Source and mask views are separate _ZoomView/QGraphicsScene instances with peer links and shared ruler; both use the same set_pixmap implementation.

Every image replacement clears old scene items, creates a new QGraphicsPixmapItem, selects DeviceCoordinateCache, updates scene/view rectangles, resets user zoom and transform, and fits aspect-preserving. New-image content therefore cannot retain the old item cache by this code path. This is also cache/transform churn for any repeated same presentation.

Message presentation clears scene and item pointer, resets transform and zoom, so save/picture() cannot expose stale image through _pixmap_item. No image cache persists as the active item after show_message.

Reset zoom resets/fits transform. Non-user-zoomed resize fits current scene; manual zoom remains preserved on resize. Wheel zoom calls cursor helper scale and copies completed transform/scroll to peer under synchronization guards. These are view-transform changes, with device cache regeneration delegated to Qt.
Cursor zoom scales view, expands view sceneRect for anchoring, recenters and restores anchor; underlying scene/image bounds unchanged. It does not replace image/item or manually disable its cache.

Ordinary paint delegates to QGraphicsView, then conditionally draws ruler on viewport with current scene mapping. No explicit item cache toggle, scene.clear, image replacement or view transform mutation is in this paint body. Cache mode is a request, not proof that this specific repaint hit a retained cache.

Image/channel/normalization and display-mode refresh rebuilds source image and selected mask/flow/overlay through set_pixmap. Later filtered-overlay/history refreshes also use the same replacement path. These invalidate by item replacement rather than leave old pixels. No claim that those callbacks actually fired during the failing measured interval.

numpy_to_qpixmap normalizes/reconciles channels to contiguous RGB888 and copies image bytes into QPixmap. Exact benchmark uses this converter for both synthetic RGB images; opaque-image simplifications are conditional candidates, not proven speedups.

Test checks each initial item reports DeviceCoordinateCache and deliberately switches item cache modes in both paths. That assertion verifies configured mode; it does not verify cache hit count, residency or pixel equivalence after resize/zoom. Those runtime facts remain unobserved here.

primary_Qt_semantics.paraphrase: Device-coordinate caching operates in paint-device coordinates and automatically regenerates under direct or indirect transforms; it preserves render quality.
primary_Qt_semantics.use: Supports normal view zoom/fit changes without extra source-level manual cache invalidation.

primary_Qt_semantics.paraphrase: Caching does not prevent paint calls when Qt drops cache data, including under memory pressure.
primary_Qt_semantics.use: Mode selected alone cannot prove cache residency or explain the measured ratio.

primary_Qt_semantics.paraphrase: fitInView during resize may recurse if automatic scrollbar states toggle.
primary_Qt_semantics.use: Existing fit-on-resize path is a conditional stability seam; no resize recursion observed or asserted.

primary_Qt_semantics.paraphrase: Bounding-rectangle shape is faster than alpha-mask shape but ignores transparent regions; pixmap item default is mask shape.
primary_Qt_semantics.use: Conditional opaque-image shape optimization hypothesis, with semantics constraints.

optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.idea: Have the owning Qt engineer verify item identity/content revision, transform/viewport/DPR stability and actual item paint/cache regeneration during the exact replay before changing caching.
optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.needed_evidence: Cache-rebuild counts and geometry/content changes aligned to cached interval; existing cacheMode assertion alone is insufficient.
optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.scope_limit: Instrumentation/execution not performed here; measurement methodology remains the other reviewer scope.

optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.idea: Avoid repeated full scene/item recreation and refit when a display revision truly did not change; consider retaining the item and updating only changed pixmap content.
optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.needed_evidence: Show refresh callbacks/item replacement during steady display or other real use; current benchmark sets images before sampling, so this is not established as its cause.
optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.correctness_constraints: Bind image/mask/mode/normalization/outline/channel content revision; preserve new-image zoom reset, messages/null images, scene bounds, cache invalidation and original-resolution picture export.

optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.idea: If cache eviction/regeneration is observed with stable content/transform, inspect actual device-cache footprint and other Qt cached pixmaps before any bounded cache-budget adjustment or owned rendered-image cache.
optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.needed_evidence: Measured cache residency/footprint at actual viewport and device pixel ratio; no global cache limit, memory pressure or eviction has been observed by this audit.
optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.correctness_constraints: Do not blindly raise global budget or infer process memory from image size; owned caches need resize/zoom/DPR/content keys, transparent compositing and bounded release.

optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.idea: For confirmed fully opaque images only, consider BoundingRectShape instead of default mask shape if shape/opaque-area processing is measured as material.
optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.needed_evidence: Alpha/shape flags and actual shape-related cost, not just cache-mode timing. Current RGB converter may already make this trivial; no benefit asserted.
optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.correctness_constraints: Do not change transparent-image hit/occlusion behavior; retain ruler, pan/hover, export and overlay semantics.

optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.idea: If resize/scrollbar toggling is observed, prevent redundant fit-on-resize loops while retaining intended fit versus manual-zoom behavior.
optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.needed_evidence: Actual resize/fit/transform event trace; no per-paint fit or recursion is present in the inspected Python paint body.
optimization_hypotheses_not_verified.correctness_constraints: Do not disable scrolling/pan or alter geometry simply to meet benchmark; preserve cursor/peer anchoring and mask/source alignment.

conclusion: No missing explicit cache setup or stale-image invalidation defect is established in the inspected path. Normal transform-triggered regeneration agrees with primary Qt semantics. Source and reported near-threshold ratio do not establish actual cache misses, regression, flake cause or successful optimization. Owning Home Qt engineer must validate runtime repair with threshold unchanged.
